acceptance_predicates.description: RecordingIndex::insert requires exact reviewed provider-profile identity, digest, and generation binding.
Missing, stale, or mismatched identity is rejected before index or cassette mutation.
Human and --json diagnostics identify the typed identity failure without secrets or response content.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and keys remain warnings and do not block local/mock setup.

definition_of_done: Focused positive, mismatch, stale, missing, and no-mutation tests pass.
Full relevant tests, privacy, independent review, and hosted checks pass.
